item.title: EasyVecDB Launches Comprehensive Vector Database Learning Project
item.description:
EasyVecDB Launches Comprehensive Vector Database Learning Project

EasyVecDB is a learning project aimed at developers and researchers, providing a systematic study of vector database systems.

🔍 Overview

  • Focuses on three directions:
    • 理论入门：理解向量数据库的原理、架构与索引机制
    • 实战教程：掌握 Milvus / Faiss / Annoy 的使用与优化技巧
    • 项目案例：从零构建 RAG、嵌入检索、聚类可视化等完整项目

🧩 How it works

The content is organized into two parts:

  • 基础学习篇
  • 实践篇

Navigation links:

  • Chapter 1 项目介绍
  • Chapter 2 为什么需要向量数据库
  • Chapter 3 向量嵌入算法基础
  • Chapter 4 向量搜索算法基础
  • Chapter 5 ANN 搜索算法
  • Chapter 5 Vamana 算法
  • Chapter 5 DiskANN 系统
  • Chapter 6 实现你自己的向量数据库
  • Annoy 入门与环境搭建
  • FAISS 入门与环境搭建
  • Milvus 向量数据库入门：认知与架构

⚙️ Key details

  • Practical tutorials cover Milvus, FAISS, and Annoy.
  • Projects demonstrate real-world applications:
Project Link Description
Project 1 基于Annoy的推荐系统召回 ./docs/projects/project1/README.md Annoy + DSSM 推荐召回
Project 2 基于FAISS框架RAG实战项目 ./docs/projects/project2/README.md RAG with FAISS
Project 3 基于Milvus框架的Agent项目 ./docs/projects/project3/README.md Agent with Milvus
Project 4 基于Milvus和ArangoDB的RAG系统 ./docs/projects/project4/README.md RAG with Milvus & ArangoDB

🚀 Availability

All chapter documents and project code are available as Markdown files in the project’s repository.

💡 Why it matters

This learning path covers fundamentals, algorithm principles, and production deployment, making it a comprehensive resource for anyone working with vector databases.

item.title: Development of a RAG-enabled Chatbot using LangChain and LLaMA
item.description:
Development of a RAG-enabled Chatbot using LangChain and LLaMA

A new RAG-powered chatbot implementation has been developed using LangChain to orchestrate an LLaMA model and NVIDIA embeddings. The system is designed to provide context-aware responses by retrieving relevant documentation from a FAISS-backed vector store.

🧩 How it works

The system processes information by generating embeddings for documents, storing them in a FAISS index, and retrieving context for the LLaMA model during query generation. The pipeline supports both basic and RAG-enabled reasoning, with performance verified through LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation techniques.

⚙️ Key details

Component Function
LangChain Orchestrates LLM components and pipeline chaining
LLaMa Handles text generation based on retrieved context
FAISS Enables efficient similarity search and document retrieval
NVIDIA Embeddings Generates vector representations of documents
FastAPI Exposes the pipeline via RESTful APIs
Gradio Provides an interactive frontend for user testing

📂 Project Structure

  • server_app.py: FastAPI server implementation
  • 08_evaluation.ipynb: RAG pipeline implementation
  • docstore_index/: FAISS document store directory
  • frontend/: Gradio interface code
  • requirements.txt: Project dependencies

#RAG #LangChain #LLaMA #FastAPI #FAISS

Source: misterseyiayeni/retrieval-augmented-generation
